text:
maria: Heads-up: production spike of fncall schema rejects from payments service. Mostly enum mismatch on `payment_status` - seeing 'PAYMENT_DECLINED_UNKNOWN' variants.

alex: saw it. Are these coming from older mobile clients?

maria: nope, server-side adapter returning 'DECLINED' instead of the canonical enum. Validator rejects and traffic falls back to degen path.

sam: current routing policy treats fncall rejects as nonfatal and routes to degen variant; but quota/billing still counts the full invoke, so dashboard looks inflated for rejects.

jin: can we coerce enums pre-validate? e.g., map `DECLINED` -> `PAYMENT_DECLINED` or soft-accept with a `validation_notice`.

maria: that would reduce noise but risks hiding contract problems. We need telemetry + controlled rollout: a canary for an "enum-coercion" feature.

alex: proposal: 2-step rollout: 1) sampling-only (20% requests) where we log mismatch and return both reject and coerced path, 2) soft-accept (50%) with `validation_notice` flag and no billing change, 3) full soft-accept and adjust quota mapping after metrics look stable.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: canary-config v3 -> staging :rocket:

jin: dashboard ask: how will this surface? need a new metric `fncall.enum_coercions` and an alert if >0.5% per-route.

sam: also show per-route cost delta and count of rejects diverted to degen so we can justify any quota mapping change.

maria: telemetry retention note: sampling-only should capture full payload for 7 days to help root cause; later switch to headers-only to limit PII.

alex: quick mapping snippet we tested locally:

```
const enumMap = { 'DECLINED': 'PAYMENT_DECLINED', 'TIMEOUT': 'PAYMENT_TIMEOUT' };
const normalized = enumMap[raw] || raw;
```

jin: and we should annotate responses so callers can detect coercion: add header `x-redwood-validation: coerced_enum`.

sam: UX ask for Console: add a toggle under Rollouts to enable `enum-coercion` with a preflight logs panel and a "Show sample payloads" link (respecting redaction).

maria: I'll open a patch to the validator to add a coercion hook + telemetry flags. tagging @alex @jin for review.

alex: ack, will review. if sampling looks good we can flip soft-accept next week.

console-bot: Note: Created dashboard panel 'Fncall: Enum Coercion' and set alert threshold to 0.5% (email to #eng-oncall).
